documentTitle: An approval an AI cannot forge: how I gate ad spend

slides.headline: An approval an AI cannot forge.
The problem
slides.body: "confirm: true" is something the model can type itself. That's not a human decision.

slides.headline:
Gate 1,
validation
slides.body: Refused before anything is built if Meta would reject it.

slides.headline:
Gate 2,
the ceiling
slides.body: Daily and monthly limits across the whole account. No limit set means nothing that spends will run.

slides.headline:
Gate 3,
approval
slides.body: A person sees the plan and the cost, and gets a token tied to exactly that plan. Change one thing and the token is void.

slides.headline: Lifecycle
steps: ads and ad sets switched on
slides.footer: Refused if Meta rejected any ad.

slides.headline: Stopping is free
body: A wrong pause costs some delivery.
